details:
Cosmic Pulse – Mission Health Command Center

Cosmic Pulse is a mission-health monitoring and management platform designed to support astronauts and ground medical teams during space missions. It acts as a centralised command centre that helps monitor astronaut health, identify potential health risks, and improve communication between astronauts and medical professionals on Earth.

The platform provides a mission overview displaying AURORA-7 mission status, flight day, crew status, relay signal, and mission progress. It monitors several important health indicators, including vital signs, sleep and recovery, mood and stress, exercise load, radiation exposure, bone health, and cardiovascular health. These readings are combined to calculate a composite health risk score, with alerts classified as Nominal, Watch, or Action. Historical trend charts help identify changes in astronaut health over time.

Cosmic Pulse includes two operating modes: Astronaut Mode and Ground Team Mode. Astronauts can review their health status, receive recommendations, and enter new health readings. Ground medical teams can review telemetry, monitor attention queues, and manage escalations. If a health concern is detected, astronauts can escalate it to ground support, where medical staff can acknowledge the issue.

The platform also uses automatically seeded mission data and stores new health readings and escalation records in a MongoDB database, ensuring that information remains available after refreshing the application.

Benefits and Intended Impact: Cosmic Pulse aims to support early identification of health concerns, improve medical coordination, and encourage proactive healthcare during long-duration space missions. By bringing multiple health indicators into one platform, it helps astronauts and ground teams make more informed decisions and respond to potential risks efficiently.

Tools and Technologies: The project was developed as a web-based digital prototype using frontend web technologies, backend integration, and MongoDB for persistent data storage. It combines interactive dashboards, health visualizations, role-based interfaces, and data management features.

Creativity and Innovation: The creative aspect of Cosmic Pulse is its combination of mission monitoring, astronaut health tracking, composite risk scoring, personalized recommendations, and two-way escalation management in a single platform. Instead of displaying health readings separately, it brings them together to provide a clearer picture of astronaut well-being.

Factors Considered: Our team considered astronaut safety, physical and mental well-being, radiation exposure, sleep quality, cardiovascular and bone health, exercise requirements, ease of use, reliable data storage, and effective communication between astronauts and ground medical teams.

Ultimately, Cosmic Pulse envisions a smarter and more proactive approach to astronaut healthcare, helping protect crew health and support safer, longer-duration space exploration.
